name: CC, Reply-All & Email Etiquette
equipment: A notebook and a colleague or mirror to practice speaking aloud
instructions: This lesson focuses on cc, reply-all & email etiquette -- practice these key phrases out loud:
I've CC'd Sarah so she stays in the loop.
Replying to all so the whole team has visibility.
Moving this to a separate thread to avoid cluttering the original one.
Looping in the design team for their input on this.
Try using at least two of these phrases in a short role-play scenario at work.
